issues.explanation: definition_fa is empty, yet INSO 42001 clause 3.20 prints a definition: «تعیین وضعیت یک نظام، فرایند (۳-۸) یا فعالیت.» Every other entry that has a printed definition (risk appetite, governance, stakeholder, compliance) reproduces it in definition_fa with attribution. Omitting it here is an inconsistency, not a policy choice.
issues.suggested_fix: Set definition_fa to: «تعریف در استاندارد ملی (INSO 42001، بند ۳.۲۰): تعیین وضعیت یک نظام، فرایند (۳-۸) یا فعالیت.»

issues.explanation: definition_fa ends with an editorial disambiguation note («یادداشت: «انطباق» در INSO 42001 بند ۳.۱۵ برای conformity … آن مفهوم جداست.»). This sentence is not part of any printed definition; it is an editorial remark. The same information already appears in editor_note_fa. Keeping it inside definition_fa blurs the boundary between what the standard prints and what the editors add, contrary to Rule 2 (source-specific definitions stay attributed; no silent merging).
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the «یادداشت: …» sentence from definition_fa (leave the two printed definitions from 3.2.5 and 3.2.4 intact). The conformity disambiguation is already covered in editor_note_fa.
